process.h2: From first message to a live, working system
process.intro: Here is exactly what happens after you reach out, so there is no guesswork about onboarding with Openink Hub.
steps: You tell us what you need
Send the form below, email us or call. In practice, share your business type, current challenges and the services you are considering: SEO, GMB, WhatsApp automation, HRMS or social media.
We assess and recommend a plan
Our team reviews your current setup, such as your website, socials or internal processes. Then we come back with a specific plan, not a generic pitch, usually within 1–2 business days.
We walk you through it live
A short call or demo where we show the right dashboard, explain pricing and answer every question before you commit to anything.
Once you are ready, we handle accounts, integrations (Google, Meta, WhatsApp, your CMS) and the first setup, typically live within 24–48 hours.
You get one named contact, regular performance reports and steady improvement, not a one-time handoff.
